limitations: No utility/PJM population polygon intersection was performed.
Residential service accounts are an imperfect proxy for occupied households, especially master-metered dwellings, seasonal homes and group quarters.
Statewide household size is assumed representative of each utility subterritory; actual subterritory differences are unmeasured.
2024 customer data,2020-2024 household factors and current rounded PJM headline have different vintages.
This is the geography of implemented utilities, not the population on supported tariffs, supply arrangements, solar programs or verified rate dates.
No corporate gas or unrelated affiliate territories counted.
Alliant Iowa and other MISO/California utilities add no PJM numerator.
